task_description:
Launch a new running challenge and set up initial participation and rankings:

1) Create a new challenge:
   - challenge_id: ch-2025-fall-run
   - name: Fall 2025 Run Week
   - description: Accumulate total running distance over the week; higher totals rank higher.
   - start_date: 2025-10-25
   - end_date: 2025-11-02
   - criteria: Total running distance; higher totals rank higher.

2) Re-engage an existing inactive user:
   - Activate the account for username: Brian Ortega.

3) Onboard a new participant:
   - Create a new user account:
     - username: Zara Patel
     - email: zara.patel@fitmail.com
     - profile_info: {full_name: "Zara Patel", location: "Westbrook", bio: "New to running; aiming for consistency."}
   - Activate the new account.

4) Register participants into the new challenge:
   - Usernames: Alice Chan, Brian Ortega, Zara Patel.
   - Join each of these users to challenge_id: ch-2025-fall-run.

5) Submit activity logs (activity_type: run) within the challenge dates:
   - Alice Chan: 5.1 km on 2025-10-26T08:15:00 and 4.0 km on 2025-10-28T07:50:00.
   - Brian Ortega: 3.7 km on 2025-10-26T18:30:00 and 2.5 km on 2025-10-29T06:40:00.
   - Zara Patel: 2.6 km on 2025-10-27T07:10:00 and 3.0 km on 2025-10-30T19:05:00.

6) Update the leaderboard for challenge_id ch-2025-fall-run based on total running distances from the submitted logs:
   - Alice Chan: score 9.1, rank 1
   - Brian Ortega: score 6.2, rank 2
   - Zara Patel: score 5.6, rank 3

7) Data quality improvement:
   - Normalize Ellie Fox’s profile_info to a structured object:
     - profile_info: {full_name: "Ellie Fox", location: "Highridge", bio: "Mountain hiking is my happy place!"}
   - Do not activate her account; keep her current inactive status unchanged.
